# The Cybersecurity Trade Project

## Restructuring Cybersecurity into a Recognized Skilled Trade

The Cybersecurity Trade Project is an open-source framework, technical specification, and governance standard that restructures cybersecurity from an unstructured corporate job into an accredited skilled trade. 

Modeled after established licensed professions (such as aviation, maritime defense, and electrical engineering), the trade architecture replaces fragmented vendor certifications, non-standardized titles, and predatory bootcamps with registered apprenticeships, verifiable operational runtime ledgers, objective hands-on challenge exams, professional licensure, and legal protections.

---

## The 7 Core Architectural Pillars

1. **[Pillar I: Standardized Pre-Apprenticeship (The Talent Filter)](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/pillars/01_pre-apprenticeship.html):** Zero-debt public community college on-ramps replacing commercial bootcamp debt and degree gatekeeping.
2. **[Pillar II: The Earn-While-You-Learn Pipeline](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/pillars/02_earn-while-learning.html):** Direct Day-1 W-2 employment with graduated wage steps, strictly banning unpaid labor and training repayment agreement provisions (TRAPs).
3. **[Pillar III: Progressive Rotations & Enforced Ratios](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/pillars/03_rotational-pipeline.html):** 8,000-hour cross-domain operational runtime ledger across 5 defense domains with enforced 2:1 on-shift supervisory ratios.
4. **[Pillar IV: Professional Licensure & The Journeyman Standard](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/pillars/04_licensure-and-board.html):** Independent National Cybersecurity Trade Board (NCTB) credential clearinghouse and proctored hands-on practical challenge examinations.
5. **[Pillar V: Personal Liability & The Right of Technical Refusal](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/pillars/05_personal-liability-and-refusal.html):** Statutory legal standing to refuse unsafe deployments via Form FORM-001 (Notice of Safety Non-Concurrence), shifting liability to corporate executives who override in writing.
6. **[Pillar VI: Craft Guilds, Labor Trusts & Collective Defense](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/pillars/06_craft-guilds-and-labor-trusts.html):** Taft-Hartley multi-employer benefit trusts, Hour-Bank healthcare portability, and automatic legal defense funds.
7. **[Pillar VII: The Insurance-Driven Market Catalyst](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/pillars/07_insurance-catalyst.html):** 25% to 35% cyber insurance warranty discounts for participating employers that maintain verified skilled trade staffing ratios.

---

## Interactive Ecosystem Web Applications

* **[Specification Documentation Portal](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/the-cyber-trade-project/):** Comprehensive specifications, governance bylaws, operational field roles, and procedural forms.
* **[Career Tier & Prior Learning Estimator](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/cyber-trade-estimator/):** Privacy-first client-side evaluation engine calculating provisional trade tier placement, grandfathering credits, and wage milestones.
* **[Universal Digital Logbook PWA](https://the-cyber-trade-project.github.io/cyber-trade-logbook/):** Offline-first cryptographic runtime ledger supporting WebCrypto AES-256-GCM vault security, FIDO2/WebAuthn supervisor attestations, and actuarial audit exports.

---

## Active Repositories

* **[the-cyber-trade-project](https://github.com/the-cyber-trade-project/the-cyber-trade-project):** Core framework specifications, governance charters, procedural templates, and interactive portal.
* **[cyber-trade-estimator](https://github.com/the-cyber-trade-project/cyber-trade-estimator):** Single-page application and mathematical evaluation engine for trade tier and PLA calculations.
* **[cyber-trade-logbook](https://github.com/the-cyber-trade-project/cyber-trade-logbook):** Universal digital ledger Progressive Web App and cryptographic validation CLI.
